name: bm-r2-collagen-network-rheology
title: Faithful collagen IV network rheology
question: Is basement-membrane stress relaxation proportional to collagen IV molecular residence (turnover) time?
hypothesis: In the LAMMPS NC1/7S network under paper-matched staged loading, the measured stress- relaxation time scales linearly with the collagen molecular residence time set by the turnover rate, reproducing Figure 2D traces and the 2E slope within run-to-run variance.
objective: Run the LAMMPS NC1/7S network under paper-matched staged loading and chemistry switches across several turnover rates; independently track molecule residence time and stress relaxation; reproduce Fig 2D stress traces and the 2E slope with error bars.
description:
The molecular-scale reproduction (Barrientos Fig 2D-E) and the frozen R2 stress-test that
gate P0. The faithful collagen IV network (released NC1/7S angles, density and turnover
controls established in bm-v1/bm-v4) is driven through staged loading with the crosslink
chemistry switched on at several turnover rates. Molecule residence time and the macroscopic
stress-relaxation time are measured independently so their proportionality (Fig 2E) is a
genuine prediction, not an identity. Engine-level mechanics and run-to-run variance are
benchmarked here.

expected_behavior.name: relaxation-scales-with-residence-time
expected_behavior.observable: stress-relaxation time vs collagen molecular residence time
expected_behavior.rationale: Matching the Fig 2E slope with error bars (not just direction) is the quantitative P1 criterion and the frozen reference stress test for P0.

expected_behavior.name: stress-traces-match-fig2d
expected_behavior.rationale: Fig 2D stress traces must reproduce in shape and magnitude within benchmarked variance.
